_about: Benchmark questions for the Tables Turned preprint. Each question is posed to every arm. 'question' + 'context' feed the Tables Turned form fields; 'search_query' is what a person would type into a search box (AI Overview arm); 'chat_prompt' is what a person would type into a free chatbot (Claude free arm). All three carry the same information.
followup_prompt: Can you list the specific scientific studies this is based on? Please include the authors, year, journal, and PubMed ID for each.

questions.question: Does melatonin help kids sleep?
questions.context: My 7-year-old has trouble falling asleep. Deciding whether to try melatonin gummies before school starts.
questions.chat_prompt: Does melatonin help kids sleep? My 7-year-old has trouble falling asleep and I'm deciding whether to try melatonin gummies before school starts.
